name: X127
description: British water lighter from 1915, 24 m long, sunk in March 1942 in Marsamxett Harbour off Manoel Island. Lies upright on a slope from 5 m at the bow to 22 m at the stern, an easy shore dive for almost any level. For years divers called it Carolita or Coralita; it was identified as X127 in 2006.
conditions: Harbour water: visibility is lower than on the open coast.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
